Gardner Lewis Asset Management LP increased its stake in Akorn Inc. (AKRX) by 5.56% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gardner Lewis Asset Management LP bought 204,016 shares as the company’s stock declined 53.53% with the market. The institutional investor held 3.87M shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $72.49 million, up from 3.67M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gardner Lewis Asset Management LP who had been investing in Akorn Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.83B market cap company. The stock increased 1.04% or $0.15 during the last trading session, reaching $14.6. About 2.24 million shares traded. Akorn, Inc.
